description: For a satisfiable finite Horn theory, an atom belongs to every model exactly when it belongs to the forward closure.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.positive_consequence.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.Rule α))
  (hs : ∃ X, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.models Γ X) (p : α) :
  (∀ (X : Set α), Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.models Γ X → p ∈ X) ↔
    p ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.closure Γ
